reuse.why: Uses getMonthWideCategories, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring; the income-skip check and expense sign flip are inlined as in the sibling actions rather than shared.

duplication.why: Only the per-category income-skip guard and is_income sign flip repeat what every sibling month-wide action already inlines; no larger block is copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to setZero/set3MonthAvg and is registered in budget/app.ts like the other budget methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type/registration and a test are added.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; a maintainer would own it easily, though the repeated income/sign rules stay scattered across actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthWideCategories and writes through setBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income-skip/sign-flip lines are written in the same form as the sibling actions, not disguised.
